TITLE: McKesson Q2 2027: a 9% EPS beat and higher guide meet a full multiple
QUOTE: Our pharmaceutical distribution business continues to perform well, supported by stable market fundamentals operational excellence, and our differentiated customer value proposition.
QUOTE_WHO: Brian S. Tyler, Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings call, 4 November 2026
COMPANY_INTRO: McKesson distributes medicines and medical supplies to pharmacies, hospitals and clinics, and runs oncology and prescription technology businesses. North American Pharmaceutical is 82% of revenue; Q2 revenue was $111bn. NYSE listed.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Result
TAKEAWAYS.text: Adjusted EPS of $11.68 beat consensus by 9.0% and grew 18% year on year.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Engine
TAKEAWAYS.text: North American Pharmaceutical profit rose 22% to $1.04bn, 14.8% above consensus.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Guidance
TAKEAWAYS.text: Fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guide raised 3.1% at the midpoint, to $45.60–46.40.

TAKEAWAYS.label: Reaction
TAKEAWAYS.text: Shares rose 0.24% on 5 November, 7.2% since 3 November: the beat looks priced in.

H_P1: Results: the beat was large, the reaction small
P1_PARAGRAPH: Adjusted EPS beat consensus by 9.0% and revenue by 0.9%, yet the shares rose only 0.24% on 5 November, taking the gain since 3 November to 7.2%. Forward EPS rose only 2.4%, so the multiple did the work: 21.7x, a 55% premium to the 14.0x average since 2005. We think the beat was largely in the price.
C1_TITLE: MCK: Q2 2027 results vs. Bloomberg consensus
C1_SUB: Surprise vs. Bloomberg consensus, % · revenue, adjusted operating profit by segment, adjusted EPS
C1_COMMENT: Every profit line beat except Medical-Surgical, 14.8% below consensus. North American Pharma beat by 14.8%, Rx Technology by 5.5% and Oncology by 3.6%. The 9.0% EPS beat exceeds the 7.4% profit beat, helped by a 6% lower share count.
BASE_CASE: We underwrite 12-month forward EPS of about $51, 3% above consensus, in line with the 3.1% lift in the guide midpoint to $46.00. At 21x that gives about $1,070, today’s price, so we see the risk/reward as balanced. Upside is $1,150 (EPS of $53 at 21.7x, +7%). Downside is $945 (today’s EPS at the one-year average P/E of 19.1x, −12%), level with the 40-day average. Next tests: the Q3 print and the Medical-Surgical separation.
UPSIDE: North American Pharmaceutical profit growth of 20% or more in Q3, after 22% in Q2. Consensus fiscal 2027 EPS above $46.40, the top of the guide. Medical-Surgical profit holding above $225m.
DOWNSIDE: North American Pharmaceutical profit growth below 15% as GLP-1 volumes normalise. Prescription Technology profit growth below 10%. A price above $1,150 without upgrades.
H_A1: Results: pharma distribution did the work
A1_PARAGRAPHS: North American Pharmaceutical revenue rose 6% to $91.36bn and adjusted operating profit rose 22% to $1.04bn, from 19% growth in Q1, on higher volumes from health systems, retail national accounts and specialty products. GLP-1 distribution revenue reached $16bn, up 26%. Oncology and Multispecialty revenue grew 24% to $14.98bn and profit 8% to $427m; excluding a $51m net gain in the prior year, profit grew 23%, although margin fell 45bp. Prescription Technology Solutions profit grew 18% to $307m, helped by Medicare GLP-1 Bridge enrolment while prior-authorisation volumes began to normalise. Medical-Surgical profit fell 10% to $225m on ambulatory product mix and separation charges.

Surprise and reaction diverge: a 9.0% EPS beat produced a 0.24% gain on 5 November. The confirmed facts are the 7.2% rise from the 3 November close, which took the P/E from 20.7x to 21.7x, and consensus EPS rising only 2.4% over the same days. The most likely reading is that positioning had already absorbed the beat; this is consistent with, but not confirmed by, the price standing 13.7% above its 40-day average. Medical-Surgical profit, 14.8% below consensus, also tempered the print. Forward EPS of $49.4 already sits 7% above the guide midpoint, so the market is valuing fiscal 2028 earnings.
H_A2: Outlook: guide raised, deals add from fiscal 2028
A2_PARAGRAPH: Management lifted fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $45.60–46.40 from $44.20–45.00, which implies 19% to 21% growth, above the long-term 13% to 16% target. The company closed the $2.25bn acquisition of Precision Medicine Group and announced a $1.4bn investment for a 49% stake in Option Care Health. The CVS Health contract now runs through 2032. Analysts estimate accretion from Precision Medicine Group at $1.60–1.80 per share by year three. Prescription Technology Solutions targets 10% to 13% profit growth and delivered 18%; the Bridge program added an estimated 3 to 4 points, so we model growth easing towards the target range.
C2_TITLE: MCK: share price vs. consensus earnings and valuation
C2_SUB: MCK US Equity, daily · BEst 12m-forward consensus · 40-day simple MA · log scale · P/E shaded above (orange) / below (blue) its 2005 to 2026 average · last price is the 5 November close
C2_COMMENT: Over 12 months the price rose 27% to $1,072 and 12-month forward EPS rose 19% to $49.4, so earnings carried most of the move. The P/E stands at 21.7x, a 55% premium to the 14.0x average since 2005, 13% above its one-year average of 19.1x and just below the 22.7x peak of 3 March 2026. The price is 13.7% above its 40-day average of $943. A 10% EPS upgrade at an unchanged price would bring the P/E to 19.7x, close to the one-year average.
SOURCE_LINE: Source: Syz Research, Bloomberg, company filings, analyst research as of 5 November 2026
